## Objective

Deliver the complete second-release ontology system on the current verified v1 foundation, with standards interoperability, formal inference and AI proposals, guarded actions and real local visual editing.

User value: Agents and people can inspect, reason about and improve project knowledge using exact evidence while existing operational authority, history and project ownership remain controlling.

### Success outcomes

- All 44 TRD requirements and every source acceptance criterion are implemented and evidenced through real interfaces.
- Supported RDF/SPARQL/SHACL and inference operate with observable access restrictions, semantic limits and derivation provenance.
- A real permitted agent generates a sourced proposal that can be validated/refined, rejected or exactly published through current authority.
- Every delivered action family executes through its guard and owning authorizer, with no mutation on invalid/unauthorized/stale inputs.
- A user completes real browser authoring/review/publication and conflict recovery through accessible graph and non-graph controls.
- Advanced packets, memory preservation, neutral setup, populated-project upgrades and selected root adoption pass integrated acceptance.

## Scope

### In scope

- All REQ-001 through REQ-044, preserving each original criterion and dependency.
- Versioned companion contracts; isolated pinned profiles; RDF dataset/provenance/interchange; read-only bounded SPARQL and SHACL.
- Approved finite formal rules with proofs and conflict states; real native proposal generation, validation, exact review/publication and bounded refinement.
- Ontology-only semantic/vector fallback and reproducible competency comparison.
- Actual guard adapters for all required owning helper families including recovery and setup, plus explicit covered/uncovered reporting.
- Local trusted-session workbench with usable exploration, real authoring, review, publication and durable conflict-preserved drafts.
- Advanced frozen context, unchanged memory/Task semantics, reusable distribution, exact root adoption, neutral new setup and explicitly selected populated-project upgrades.
- Actual backend, model, browser, dispatch and native integration acceptance with final forward/reverse evidence and preservation audits.

### Out of scope

- Performing implementation, profile installation, model preparation, Task execution or canonical ontology publication during this plan-creation operation.
- Autonomous ontology acceptance, inferred permission, model training or self-modifying runtime.
- Memory or Task schema/corpus/backend/capture migration, cross-project recursive ingestion, automatic product adoption or a second operational authority ledger.
- Hosted graph database, hosted/public workbench, universal host-wide tool/shell interception, Git commit/push, external communication/publication or deployment.
- Changing the first-release TRD/plan lifecycle or other existing managed artifacts as a consequence of this plan.

### Execution authority

Creating, approving or tracking this plan does not authorize implementation, execution, dependency/model installation, service startup, canonical ontology publication, Task execution, project adoption, Git or another separately governed action. Execute only an exact separately authorized plan through the applicable project workflow; each separately governed runtime, mutation and adoption must have its scoped current authority. Current user clarification: only the requested plan operation is authorized; package installation and runtime compatibility execution are not authorized by this operation.

### Constraints

- Preserve v1 canonical semantics, project isolation, stable IDs, imported locks and independent memory/Task state.
- Reusable changes belong in owning depot sources; mapped Template and explicit root adoption follow their exact separate manifests.
- All four capability areas and both reasoning modes are mandatory deliverables. Optional provisioning never makes implementation or enabled-mode acceptance optional.
- Core commands remain Python 3.12 standard-library operations. No advanced profile or model is installed, started, upgraded or downloaded by a read or approval.
- Use owning helpers for state mutation; no replacement Task/memory/authority ledger and no universal host interceptor.
- Existing uncommitted changes are preserved. Runtime/action/publication/Git authority must be explicit and is not created by this plan.

## Decisions

| Decision | Status | Statement | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DEC-001` | `proposed` | Retain ontology.yaml, core module/context and existing authoring records at v1. Add a strict ontology-advanced.yaml companion and manifested ONTOLOGY/extensions/ for approved rules, shapes, semantic annotations and action contracts. Old core commands continue to read v1 only; advanced readers reject unsupported companion versions. Extensions cannot be placed in v1 record files, redefine locked core IDs or silently acquire publication scope. Extend the existing publisher with an explicitly versioned advanced proposal contract and separately reviewed destination-local grants. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-002` | `proposed` | Use in-memory RDFLib Dataset projections with stable named graphs for asserted, derived, inferred and external facts; canonical files remain the only authoring sources. Use JSON-LD dataset interchange plus selected-graph Turtle/RDF/XML with a required context/provenance manifest. Imports become durable proposals; unsupported lossless conversions are rejected. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-003` | `proposed` | Select candidate standards pins rdflib==7.6.0, pyshacl==0.40.1 and owlrl==7.6.2 in .venv-ontology-standards, with all transitive versions and wheel hashes locked. The Python 3.12 metadata resolver passed, but actual runtime compatibility tests are a planning prerequisite before readiness. Do not install into the core or memory pilot environments. Standards extras enabling JavaScript, remote stores or HTTP servers are not selected. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-004` | `proposed` | Use a supervised, isolated Python worker on the inspected macOS host, with OS-enforced allowlisted file access and no network access for standards/reasoning. The observed sandbox-exec launcher is a host-specific candidate, contingent on actual adversarial denial tests; unsupported confinement must report unavailable and block enabled operations. Add parsed-query/axiom/shape allowlists and a closed plugin registry, clean environment and bounded IPC. Do not represent Python string filters or audit hooks alone as a security boundary. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-005` | `proposed` | Initial configurable advanced budgets are 8 MiB selected input, 50000 input triples, 10 seconds/query, 500 result rows, 1 MiB query output, 30 seconds/reasoning, 100000 derived triples, 128 rule rounds, 10000 derivation nodes/result, two workers and 512 MiB RSS/worker. Guard evaluation uses at most 5 seconds. Measure memory-limit enforcement and overshoot on the supported host; unavailable enforcement blocks a profile claiming it. Preserve core 32000-byte output and Task 250000-byte/200-reference packet limits. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-006` | `proposed` | Implement a finite, deterministic forward-rule profile for named class/subproperty propagation, class/property equivalence, approved individual equality, inverse, symmetric and transitive properties, plus explicit disjointness/negative-assertion conflict cases. Record proof DAGs with exact premises/rule IDs; use OWL-RL as a differential oracle for supported positive cases, not as unexamined proof output. Unsupported constructs fail explicitly; absent facts remain unproven and inconsistent components are quarantined from trusted results. This is a documented subset, not full OWL 2 RL conformance. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-007` | `proposed` | Use the already permitted native agent runtime through the ontology skill for proposal generation and refinement. The skill creates an immutable selected source request, performs an actual authorized model/agent run, captures exact structured candidate bytes and available native/model settings, and attaches them through the same durable proposal API used by the workbench. The browser can prepare requests and review captured proposals; it never fabricates a generator result or silently selects a new provider. Permit an initial run plus two finding-directed revisions, then stop with unresolved evidence. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-008` | `proposed` | Keep drafts/proposals and immutable revision/review history under ONTOLOGY/proposals/, and approval/publication/recovery receipts under control_records/ontology/. Keep projections, inference closure, query caches and vectors under .sys4ai/ontology/. Use the existing publisher for accepted semantics; do not add a second authorization ledger. Browser saved drafts survive reload and projection rebuilding. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-009` | `proposed` | Provide a separately provisioned .venv-ontology-semantic profile based on fastembed==0.8.0 and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, with a selected immutable ONNX model revision/hash and an ontology-only cache. Exact ID, preferred label, alias and explicit graph results precede vector fallback. Use a bounded local matrix/cosine index rather than a graph database or memory backend. Model preparation is explicit; reads use offline local files only. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-010` | `proposed` | Install guards at owning public mutation and recovery boundaries for ontology, memory, Task, TRD, plan, role, Template asset and project setup/adoption operations. Normalize and schema-check first, check semantic validity, then preserve each existing authorizer; under the owning lock revalidate changed semantic/authority context before invoking the mutation continuation. Bind decisions to arguments, target version, rules, sources and current manager generation. Report direct host/shell/third-party paths outside these adapters as uncovered. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-011` | `proposed` | Enable the guard profile only after all declared family adapters and an immutable bootstrap/repair contract are verified. Preserve recovery decisions against accepted pre/post snapshots and original receipts. An explicit repair/upgrade selects exact files and current authority and validates its retained repair contract; it never silently disables an enabled guard or reinterprets uncertain state. If its validation backend is unavailable, repair and covered actions remain blocked until a separately authorized profile provisioning operation restores it. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-012` | `proposed` | Build a loopback-only Python service and local HTML/CSS/JavaScript ES modules with bounded SVG graph interactions plus equivalent list/forms. Avoid a Node build/runtime dependency. A trusted CLI/agent launch establishes a short-lived server-side session and operation scope; browser-supplied actors, grants and native receipts are ignored as authority. Use origin/Host checks, CSRF protection, single-use bootstrap, safe text rendering, restrictive CSP, path confinement and exact review/target versions; session credentials stay outside plans, logs and URLs persisted as evidence. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-013` | `proposed` | Extend ontology packets through an explicit advanced packet version that retains existing Task artifact path/hash interfaces and size limits. Freeze selected inference proofs, rules/shapes/profiles, dataset selection and semantic source/index/model context. Legacy packet readers reject advanced packets clearly. The manager alone assesses new context and repeats existing input/review gates; live guards never replace solver packets. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
| `DEC-014` | `proposed` | Distribute reusable sources through the existing updater, then adopt exact verified root files using a reviewed manifest. Use a new governance-starter-v9 edition for new/first-prepared projects, retaining editions v1-v8. Add a separately selected ontology-advanced adoption/upgrade route in existing module_adoptions receipts that distinguishes receipt-owned capability files from authored ontology/proposals and preserves user data, imports, licensing, memory choices and customized packages. No ordinary product project is selected for rollout. | Proposed implementation design constrained by the selected TRD; current-user approval of the exact canonical revision is pending. |
